notes: The exhaustive m=3 value of arXiv:2605.28586, reproduced here from scratch: every rank-3 triple over the 30240 three-qutrit stabilizer states is excluded by the pivot-and-quotient search of rank_exclusion.py, with rank 2 excluded in the same pass. Together with the Lean-checked rank-4 decomposition this settles chi(|H3>^3) = 4 with both directions machine-checked. The exclusion is numerical and rests on a margin: the certificate reports the closest any two non-parallel quotient directions come to the parallel threshold and refuses to print its claim if that margin is under 0.01. The Norrell state at m=2, whose rank-3 decomposition is proved in Lean, is the positive control.
